title: Structured Time-Frequency Representation for Channel Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.35956v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate CSI forecasting is essential for mitigating channel aging and supporting reliable downlink transmission in high-mobility wireless systems. In FDD systems, forecasting future DL CSI from historical UL observations requires joint temporal extrapolation and cross-band inference. However, defining historical UL as the input and future DL as the target does not specify how elapsed time and UL-to-DL band separation should be represented in a pretrained predictor's positional space. FAR-CSI establishes an FDD-aware representation of channel forecasting within a joint temporal and operating-band positional field. Within this field, historical UL observations and future DL targets occupy segregated regions according to their temporal and operating-band roles, preserving the distinction between observed UL context and unobserved DL prediction targets. translated_title: 面向信道预测的结构化时频表示
translated_abstract: 准确的信道状态信息（CSI）预测对于缓解信道老化问题以及在高移动性无线系统中支持可靠的下行链路传输至关重要。在频分双工（FDD）系统中，从历史上行（UL）观测数据预测未来下行（DL）CSI需要同时进行时间外推和跨频段推断。然而，仅将历史UL定义为输入、未来DL定义为目标，并未说明在预训练预测器的位置空间中应如何表示流逝的时间以及UL到DL的频段分离。FAR-CSI在联合的时间与工作频段位置域中建立了一种FDD感知的信道预测表示。在该位置域中，历史UL观测与未来DL目标根据其时间和工作频段角色占据相互分离的区域，从而保留了已观测的UL上下文与未观测的DL预测目标之间的区别。该表示通过一个统一的结构化路由规则来实例化，该规则支配……
tldr: 该论文提出FAR-CSI框架，通过在联合的时间与工作频段位置域中构建FDD感知的结构化表示，使历史UL观测与未来DL预测目标在位置空间中占据分离区域，从而实现FDD系统中从上行观测到下行CSI的准确信道预测。
en_tdlr: FAR-CSI establishes an FDD-aware structured representation within a joint temporal and operating-band positional field, where historical UL observations and future DL targets occupy segregated regions, enabling accurate channel prediction from uplink observations to downlink CSI in FDD systems.
